title: A Scholar’s Odyssey
author: Prof. Mukesh Pandey, Vice Chancellor of Bundelkhand University, Jhansi
description:
Born in Sanchi in 1968, he grew up watching his father serve farmers and carrying his
uncle’s lesson to be like a lamp that burns to light the way for others. The book follows him
from a school windmill project, through engineering, doctoral research and academic
leadership, to the call from Rajbhavan, Lucknow, that made him Vice Chancellor.
Across eight chapters, with a foreword by Prof. P. B. Sharma, it shows the principles behind
his achievements: humility, resilience and service.
